# The rod: a 2.8 m pole from the handle (origin: the pivot the game bends it about) along +X, tilted
# up 18 degrees, a cork grip and a reel at the handle. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rod --base-color 0.451 0.275 0.298 --no-slot
material new Grip --base-color 0.933 0.416 0.486 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Rod --size 1 --location 1.4 0 0
scale 2.8 0.08 0.08
apply --scale
active Rod
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 1.0"
scale 1 0.7 0.7
mode object
material assign Rod
add mesh cube --name Grip --size 1 --location 0.05 0 0
scale 0.5 0.12 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Grip
add mesh cylinder --name Reel --vertices 6 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.08 --location 0.25 0 -0.1 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Rod
select all
set rotation 0 -18 0
apply --rotation
shade flat
export rod.glb
